project: LEXIGEN V8 Interventional Performance World Model
inherits_v7_result: V7 GSO pilot failed; V7 branches remain immutable
goal: Before any autonomous optimization campaign, test whether a frozen model learned from measured code interventions predicts intervention validity and performance effects on unseen repositories better than simple and shuffled controls.
evaluation_split: leave_one_repository_out; no records from the held-out repository may influence model fitting, feature normalization, intervention statistics or threshold selection
kill_rules: Kill IPWM if conditional model does not materially beat intervention-frequency and static-feature baselines on unseen repositories.
Kill IPWM if shuffled intervention-effect labels retain similar performance.
Kill IPWM if performance disappears under repository-family holdout.
Kill IPWM if model confidence is not meaningfully related to realized prediction quality.
Kill IPWM if retrieval-only baseline matches the full effect model once a real corpus exists.
Kill IPWM before an optimization campaign if its gain comes only from repository/language identity memorization.
